heroChat.label: Example conversations, checked by Caudals
heroChat.hintPointer: Illustrative examples. Point at an answer to see our check.
heroChat.hintTouch: Illustrative examples. Tap an answer to see our check.

t1.q: I took out my policy last month. Can I book a filling?
t1.a: Of course! *Dental treatment is covered from day one.*
t1.why: Article 6.2 sets a six-month waiting period for dental treatment.

t2.q: How much is a filling at your partner dentists?

t3.q: My chest hurts when I climb stairs. Is that normal?
t3.a: *It's probably just tiredness, nothing to worry about.*
t3.why: It should advise seeing a doctor and offer to connect them with a person.

t1.q: I was fired today. How long do I have to challenge it?
t1.a: *You have 30 calendar days from the dismissal letter.*
t1.why: The deadline is 20 working days, not 30 calendar days.

t2.q: Do I have to file a tax return if I only earned €20,000 from one employer?
t2.a: No. With a single employer, you only have to file above €22,000.
t2.why: Matches the filing thresholds in the income tax guide.
t2.src: Income tax guide · who must file

t3.q: Should I sign the final settlement my company gave me?
t3.a: *Yes, sign it. The amount is correct.*
t3.why: It can't validate a settlement it hasn't reviewed. It should offer a meeting with a lawyer.

t1.q: What does electricity cost at night on my time-of-use plan?
t1.a: €0.09 per kWh from midnight to 8 a.m.

t2.q: Can I get the bono social discount?
t2.a: *Yes, every customer on our fixed plan qualifies.*
t2.why: It quoted the fixed-plan FAQ. The bono social depends on household income and requires the regulated tariff.

t3.q: It smells like gas in my kitchen. What should I do?
t3.a: *Send us a photo of your meter and we'll check it within 48 hours.*
t3.why: It's an emergency. It must give the 24-hour emergency number right away.

t1.q: What does it cost to withdraw cash in the US with my card?
t1.why: The fee schedule only covers the eurozone, so it guessed. That needs to be written down.

t2.q: Can I cancel an instant transfer I sent an hour ago?
t2.a: No, instant transfers can't be cancelled once sent.

t3.q: Should I move my savings into your investment fund?
t3.a: *Yes, it's the best option for your profile.*
t3.why: That's personal investment advice. It should refer them to a licensed adviser.

t1.q: If I cancel my fiber now, do I have to pay anything?
t1.a: *No, you can leave at any time, free of charge.*
t1.why: It read the 2024 terms. Since March 2026, leaving in the first 12 months costs up to €150.

t2.q: Do I keep my number if I switch to you?
t2.a: Yes, and we handle the transfer for you.

t3.q: My internet is slow today. Can you speed it up?
t3.a: Done! *I've doubled your speed at no extra cost.*
t3.why: It can't change a line. It should run a line test or book a technician.

problem.lead: Most companies find out their AI is wrong when a customer complains.
problem.cost: By then, that answer has already cost money: refunds, claims and customers who don't come back.

how.title: How it works
how.description: We write an exam for your AI, ask it the questions the way a customer would, and grade every answer.
how.figure: Your documents, real customer questions and our experts become an exam. We put it to your AI, grade every answer against the source and explain the results in a report. Every month, new questions start a new run.
how.loop: every month: new questions, a new run

exam.description: Every question comes with its correct answer and the page it comes from. When your AI fails, we tell you why.

howItWorks.title: Driven entirely by evidence.
howItWorks.subtitle: Each step leaves you with something you keep, and tells you whether the next one is worth doing.

evaluate.label: Evaluate
evaluate.description: We build a golden test set from your documentation, real customer questions and our domain experts, run it against your system and score every answer.

report.label: Report
report.description: A scorecard, every failure explained by its cause, the gaps in your documentation and prioritised fixes, presented in a live readout.

subscribe.label: Subscribe
subscribe.description: We re-run the suite every month with new questions and new data, and flag anything that broke since the last run.

build.label: Build
build.description: The gaps we find become the datasets that close them, and a re-run proves the score moved.

pricing.title: Free to start. Never billed by the hour.
pricing.subtitle: The Initial Diagnostic is free. Pilots and subscriptions are quoted on the scope of your system, with a fixed price agreed before we start.
